svg.text: Colour, type, controls and spacing used by every frame. DM Sans throughout.
Navy, slate and white carry the layout; blue is the single action colour.
DM Sans. Weights 400 regular, 600 semibold, 700 bold.
Bulk discounts apply automatically to each item.
Tier is based on total units across all sizes.
Height 40 to 52, radius 8 to 10. One primary action per area.
Primary: add to cart, checkout, pay. Dark: reorder, create account. Secondary: cancel, view details.
Height 40, radius 8, 1 px Slate 300 border. Errors show after the field is left.
Pills (radius 13 to 15). Colour carries state; text says it too.
Order status chips: one per status in the database.
8 px base grid. Pages are 1000 wide with 50 px side margins; mobile is 390 with 16 px.
2 px stroke, round caps, slate or accent. A small set is enough.
